verses.1: And after these things, in the kingdom of Artaxerxes, King Persia, Ezrā, son of Shariya, son of Azariah, son of Hilkia, ruled.
verses.2: Son of Shalum, son of Zadok, son of Ahituv.
verses.3: Ben-Amariah, son of Azariah, son of Meraiot.
verses.4: Ben-Zrachya, son of Uzi, son of Bukki.
verses.5: Ben-Avisu, son of Pinchas, son of Elazar, son of Aaron, the chief priest.
verses.6: He rose from Babylon. He is a swift writer of Moses’ teachings. Moses was given by Yahweh, the God of Israel. The king gave him all his requests, as Yahweh, his God, commanded.
verses.7: And they went up from the children of Israel, from the priests, from the Levites, from the magistrates, from the scribes, and from the elders, to Jerusalem in the seventh year of Artaxerxes’ reign.
verses.8: And Jerusalem was taken in the fifth month. That was the seventh year of his reign.
verses.9: For on the first day of the month, he set up the high tower from Babylon. And on the fifth day of the month, he came to Jerusalem, as God’s good will it was for him.
verses.10: For Ezra prepared himself to teach the laws of Jehovah, and to enforce them and teach them to the Israelites.
verses.11: And this is the scribe who was given by King Artaxerxes to Ezer, the priest and scribe, to record the laws and commandments of Jehovah for Israel.
verses.12: Artachshastu, king of Malchiyya, sent his envoy to Ezerah. He brought with him the words of Allah’s commandment.
verses.13: I decree that all those who are subject to my rule in Israel’s kingdom, including its priests and rulers, shall serve me in Jerusalem. May you reign over them, my people.
verses.14: Whoever accepts this from the beginning, and seven other laws, shall be a messenger to proclaim them in the land of Judah and Jerusalem, according to the law of your God. It is in your hands.
verses.15: And they will be given silver and gold as gifts from the king. They will then offer sacrifices to the God of Israel in Jerusalem, their homeland.
verses.16: And all silver and gold will be forgotten in all the lands of Babylon, through the charity shown by the people and priests. They will donate it to the houses of God in Jerusalem.
verses.17: Everyone who receives the Holy Bread shall be filled with joy and praise. They will say, “This is the bread of life.” And they will bring it to the altar in the house of the Lord in Jerusalem.
verses.18: And whatever you do, it’s better to do it with all your heart. In other words, it’s better to serve them wholeheartedly, in obedience to their commands.
verses.19: And let them understand that it is better to go into the house of your Lord first, than to go to Jerusalem.
verses.20: And the rest of the treasures of God’s house will be given to you. You will receive them from the house of the king’s treasures.
verses.21: And from me, I shall send out a message to all those who are in need. They are all in need of help. May they be saved from their suffering. I will send out a message to them, so that they may be relieved of their troubles.
verses.22: Up to one hundred coins for kasrin, up to one hundred coins for khantin, up to one hundred coins for hamar batin, and up to one hundred coins for batin meshach. Also, there’s salt that costs one coin.
verses.23: All those who worship the name of the Lord shall be destroyed. They will serve the Lord in His house, but they will also be punished for their actions against His kingdom and His people.
verses.24: And you know that all the priests and Levites are evil people. They are those who worship idols. They are the ones who lead the people astray from the path of righteousness. They have gone astray from the way of truth.
verses.25: And let me be guided by the wisdom of your Lord. May you use me to judge and decide matters for all nations. May I serve all those who know the laws of your Lord, and those who do not know them.
verses.26: And all those who do not serve the religion of God, and the religion of His king, will be punished with death, or with other forms of punishment. They will also be forbidden from serving that religion anymore.
verses.27: Blessed be Jehovah, the God of our ancestors, who has given this to the king’s heart, so that he might honor the house of Jehovah in Jerusalem.
verses.28: And I will offer my prayers before the king and his advisors, as well as before all the officers of the king. I will become stronger by the hand of the LORD my God. I will also call leaders from Israel to come and join me.
